fidelity_contract.classical_reference: Phase-II BANDS real-valued constraints with feasibility tolerance 1e-8
fidelity_contract.false_negative: real-valued Phase-II feasible AND quantized-oracle infeasible
fidelity_contract.false_positive: quantized-oracle feasible AND real-valued Phase-II infeasible
fidelity_contract.promotion_rule: Every seed must have zero false-positive and zero false-negative witnesses, witness consistency PASS, and all proof MILPs certified.
fidelity_contract.proof_method: MILP extremum search over the full binary exact-K/group-band state space; no random sampling can promote fidelity.

oracle_spec_version: BANDS FIXED-POINT FIDELITY + REVERSIBLE ORACLE SPEC · V1
oracle_version: PHASE III · EXACT REVERSIBLE BANDS ORACLE · V1
quantization_rule: Signed round-half-away-from-zero of coefficient*2^b and band-bound*2^b; integer comparisons are exact after quantization.

reversible_oracle_contract.cardinality: Preserved by the number-preserving XY mixer; no cardinality penalty is introduced.
reversible_oracle_contract.factor_exposures: Controlled reversible signed integer additions of sealed fixed-point coefficients, lower/upper integer comparisons, flag aggregation, then uncompute.
reversible_oracle_contract.group_counts: Controlled reversible integer additions into exact count registers, lower/upper comparisons, flag aggregation, then uncompute.

selection_rule: Use the lowest fixed-point precision in 8 -> 12 -> 16 that receives an exact family-wide MILP mismatch proof; if none passes, remain blocked.
